items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: Pop Foster came over and got them from Bunk.

ctx.x: Was it a Red Book number? That's right, a Red Book.

I have those Red Books I was just showing, Dick. Oh, yeah. They belonged to Bunk, you know. That's right. They had photosites made for Bunk, and then they came over and borrowed them. So Pop Foster had them, too. Yeah, that's right. Pop Foster came over and got them from Bunk.
Did they use the Red Book much down here when you were here?

items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: We was at a party, me and Edmund Hall's party.

ctx.x: He's the trombonist up there, you know, with high ends now. Yeah.

He's a very good tromb player too, man. I was going to ask about- He looks like Buddy Joyson, aren't he? He's smaller than Buddy. Yeah, me and- We was at a party, me and Edmund Hall's party. That's the other guy, the other class player's brother. That's Edmund. He was at a party, man. Oh, yeah. He was on the floor. Juice Don, me and him on the floor. He looks something like-
More like Edmund. Looked like a juice.
